Then u is the nonnegative mixture a*delta_empty+b*Bplus(n,x)+c*delta_full with a=1/M, b=(M-1)*((1+x)^n-1)/(M*Z), c=(M-1)*x^n/Z and Bplus(S)=x^|S|/((1+x)^n-1) on nonempty subsets. Deleting k<n coordinates pushes Bplus to alpha*delta_empty+beta*Bplus(n-k,x), alpha=((1+x)^k-1)/((1+x)^n-1), beta=(1+x)^k*((1+x)^(n-k)-1)/((1+x)^n-1). Thus at most three such nonnegative components suffice under every deletion history; deleting all coordinates gives delta_empty. On the A096 AND2 tensor moment-projection root at every even n>=4, the unique root satisfies1/2<x<1 and the individual-atom minimum remains2^n-n.
